title: 41:14 thou worm Jacob. As our enemies will be as "nothing" before us (41:11- 12), so are we as nothing before the Lord. Yet, despite our mortal and spiritual weakness, the Lord will support and sustain us; he will protect and defend us. Twice he states, "I will help thee" and twice he commands, "Fear not" (41:13-14).
author: Tina M. Peterson
